findings.text: The earlier review.md says "only CSS/docs changed, no new file", but the diff adds `tokens/FigSelect.js` (48 lines); the size was overridden to "none" twice in task.jsonl. This full review replaces it.

The behaviour (pick, close, keys, one open) is JavaScript, so the shots can't show it: both shots show the same static closed and open states as before. Judged from the code in diff.patch; the agent reports a headless test in task.jsonl.
Tab moving focus out of an open `.fig-select` leaves it open (only a click, Escape or a pick closes it). This is the same as `<details>`, but a listbox usually closes on blur.
`ext/Figma/files.jsonl` gains a third `screenshots/` "gone" line. It is tooling noise and harmless, but the log now flips gone, back, gone.
